product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
scoring_contract: deterministic: every rubric axis is computed from measured state; nothing narrative can change a score

honesty.status: schematic physics for practising control discipline - smooth inputs, swing management, ordered procedure. Not equipment certification; no seat time here counts toward one, and the assessment gates still demand unaided verification runs.
honesty.walkaround: a habit-builder, not a gate: no seat is locked behind the walkaround, completing it changes no score, and it is not an equipment inspection record.
honesty.operator: SCRIPTED: a demonstration of a hand-written, deterministic control policy on a schematic single-machine simulator - a function of the seat's own gauges, the scenario's params and a level, no model behind it and no network reached. Not a learned policy, not real equipment, and not a claim about any physical robot; its runs are its own record, never credited to the learner watching it.
honesty.xr: every seat is operable inside a WebXR session through the `xr` mapping it carries: thumbsticks, trigger, grip and the two face buttons land in the same key state a keyboard fills, so a seat cannot tell the two apart and no rubric changes in a headset. The mapping is verified against a mocked WebXR session in headless Chromium only - no physical headset has run these seats in this build.

operator_levels.optimal: the reference: the written procedure with its checks and waits intact - passes every pass-gated rubric axis on every regional scenario, proven by the build
operator_levels.novice: the same procedure with seeded, deterministic slips - a mis-selected rack, a wrong signal, a wandering standoff, a low carry - so the sweep also yields labelled sub-optimal episodes
operator_levels.hurried: the same procedure with its waits and checks removed - no settle before release, no containment before the trigger, no chart read before the hook - the failure a rushed shift actually produces
